# nettle / fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der` ([source](source/fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der.c), unmodified) over nettle (git.lysator.liu.se/nettle/nettle at bb9bba13).

rsa_keypair_from_der(&pub, &priv, 0, size, data) (which runs rsa_*_key_prepare internally); result discarded, no signature/encryption with the key.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against nettle at commit bb9bba13.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch nettle` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der.plain` | 144,176 | `5238bd4f33102989aa77719bc3d7a70c73ba749acd461f3fa1b7b605f9554b4c` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der.ubsan` | 144,656 | `3a84317b2f79a84c93d910e54670bf1b1c27156c470ae2a20bfba5cc20d96daa` |
| asan | `fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der.asan` | 665,064 | `ea9d3cccd8024eea674d69a16c6d3307b3b7a17c86db99e75bfb9d277914afae` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_rsa_keypair_from_der.asan-ubsan` | 664,664 | `20cce16fda929f9709a8dbedc36b5a7db27be97b8ca3353fd8227b7b7c19541c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
